cohort: The study included 10 parturient women with amniotic fluid embolism (AFE) who were rescued by VA-ECMO and hospitalized in two high ECMO volume centers between August 2008 and February 2021.
finding: VA-ECMO use is supported in AFE despite intense DIC and ongoing bleeding, with 70% of patients alive at hospital discharge, though their health-related quality of life remained profoundly impaired after a median of 44 months.
